3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: We strolled further into the gardens. It was a balmy night, and the moon was just beginning to rise.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Under cover of darkness, Lucita slipped her hand into mine.

8.speaker: Lucita Azaro
8.text: "I can't believe Her Highness is getting married tomorrow."

9.speaker: Lucita Azaro
9.text: "I was skeptical at first, but your daughter has really come into her own as a councilor."

10.speaker: Lucita Azaro
10.text: "I still remember attending the celebrations when she was born. Her mother looked so gorgeous."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "Believe me, Princess Lena of Rumburg couldn't hold a candle to Duchess Lucita of Montaklar."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "I still miss her. But I have to move on."

13.speaker: Player_Romus
13.text: "Poor Lena. She never got to see her daughter become a woman."

19.speaker: Lucita Azaro
19.text: "She lives on in Her Highness. And in her progeny, whoever they may be..."

21.speaker: Lucita Azaro
21.text: "The blossoming flower versus the bird of prey? I know what they all say about me."

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: We had come to the clearing in the middle of the gardens. To our left was the stone bench.

28.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
28.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_RizianForeignIntelligence_Expanded"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false

29.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
29.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_RizianForeignIntelligence_Expanded"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false) == false

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: The air in the palace suddenly felt suffocating. I went out to the gardens to clear my head.
30.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_RizianForeignIntelligence_Expanded"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) == false)

31.speaker: Narrator
31.text: I had just exited the palace when I bumped into Lucita.

33.speaker: Lucita Azaro
33.text: "I was conducting last-minute security drills in the Grand Hall. You really can't be too careful with these things."

37.speaker: Lucita Azaro
37.text: "I was just reviewing our latest battle plans."

41.speaker: Lucita Azaro
41.text: "I was in the council chambers when I heard Titus' radio transmission. I can't believe the Golden Guard let this happen."

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "I suspect she's trying to flee the country. Can our foreign intelligence services help find her?"

46.speaker: Lucita Azaro
46.text: "Yes, of course. I'll tell them to be on the lookout."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "She had someone on the inside. A guard helping her out."

48.speaker: Lucita Azaro
48.text: "That's very troubling. I'll ask my intelligence operatives to look into it at once."

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "Pabel was in on it. He's vanished without a trace."

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "I think my mother might have helped her, but I have no proof."

51.speaker: Lucita Azaro
51.text: "You should get some rest, Your Majesty. Trust in your security staff to handle the situation."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "It won't be easy to rest. But I'll try."
52.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_BuildMaveNortusIntelHub_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_BuildMaveNortusIntelHub_Completed"] == true) == false)

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "No. I have to do something. I'll go crazy otherwise."
53.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_BuildMaveNortusIntelHub_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_BuildMaveNortusIntelHub_Completed"] == true) == false)

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "Wait. Take a walk with me." [Marriage Proposal]

58.speaker: Lucita Azaro
58.text: "It will all be fine. Don't worry."

59.speaker: Narrator
59.text: She gave me a terse nod.

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "Thank you, Duchess Azaro. I hope this all resolves quickly."
60.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_BuildMaveNortusIntelHub_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_BuildMaveNortusIntelHub_Completed"] == true) == false)

63.speaker: Lucita Azaro
63.text: "All right. I'm sure you could use the distraction."

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: We started walking together through the gardens. It was a balmy night.

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: Eventually, we came to the spot in the center with the stone bench.

66.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
66.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Limp"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false)

73.speaker: Narrator
73.text: She pulled back and gave me a measured look.

74.speaker: Lucita Azaro
74.text: "I believe so. My monthly visitor continues to bless me with exasperating regularity."

75.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
75.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Limp"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_KeepsLastName"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false)

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: Lucita's eyes widened. She looked at me questioningly.

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "In the presence of the heavens above and the earth below, I do extend unto thee an offer of marriage."

80.speaker: Narrator
80.text: She clapped a hand to her mouth. It was a second before she replied.

81.speaker: Lucita Azaro
81.text: "Is this because of your daughter's disappearance?"

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "I need another heir, Lucita. Preferably a boy."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "That's incidental. I've loved you since the moment you entered my council chambers."

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "With my command of the Rizian government and your command of the military, we will be unstoppable."

86.speaker: Lucita Azaro
86.text: "That's the most cold-blooded thing I've ever heard."

87.speaker: Narrator
87.text: She reached up, grabbed the back of my head and pulled my face level with hers.

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "Then I would like to request that you grant me the honor of your hand in marriage."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "Then have *my* my children, Duchess Azaro. Be my wife."

90.speaker: Lucita Azaro
90.text: "Yes, King Romus. I will marry you."

91.speaker: Lucita Azaro
91.text: "I've loved you since before we even met."

92.speaker: Lucita Azaro
92.text: "Unstoppable. I like the sound of that."

98.speaker: Lucita Azaro
98.text: "Good night, Your Majesty. I'll let you know at once if the Princess is found."

100.speaker: Narrator
100.text: I re-entered the palace, where I was greeted by Titus.

101.speaker: Titus Gordion
101.text: "Still no trace of her, Your Majesty. Your butler seems to have disappeared from the palace grounds as well."

103.speaker: Player_Romus
103.text: "Never mind that. I want to know about my mother's involvement."

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "Find them both. This is an embarrassment."

106.speaker: Titus Gordion
106.text: "As I said, I'll see what I can do."

108.speaker: Titus Gordion
108.text: "Don't give up yet. We'll bring Her Highness home."

110.speaker: Narrator
110.text: He shadowed me as I walked upstairs and into my quarters.

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: Bruno was waiting for me by my valet stand, where a brand-new, crisp royal blue suit had been hung up. Pabel had laid it out for me to wear tomorrow.

118.speaker: Narrator
118.text: Arranged on my valet stand was a brand-new, crisp royal blue suit. Pabel had laid it out for me to wear tomorrow.

119.speaker: Narrator
119.text: Bruno was waiting for me by my valet stand, where my favorite suit had been hung up. Pabel had laid it out for me to wear tomorrow.

124.speaker: Narrator
124.text: Pabel had hung up my favorite suit on the valet stand.

125.speaker: Narrator
125.text: There was a chance I would still get to wear it.

127.speaker: Narrator
127.text: I knew that I would never wear it.

129.speaker: Narrator
129.text: There was a chance tomorrow could still be a normal day.

131.speaker: Narrator
131.text: I knew that I would never wear it again.

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: She pulled back from me slightly.

136.speaker: Lucita Azaro
136.text: "I told you long ago that falling in love was like heading into battle."

140.speaker: Lucita Azaro
140.text: "Of course, that was before you and I found ourselves fighting an actual battle."

141.speaker: Lucita Azaro
141.text: "I told myself long ago that I would never fall in love. Giving yourself to someone like that allows them to have absolute power over you."

142.speaker: Lucita Azaro
142.text: "And I refuse to subjugate myself to anyone."

148.speaker: Lucita Azaro
148.text: "We've held our ground against Pales. But when it comes to the two of us... well, Your Majesty, I surrender."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "I don't know if you're lying. I don't care. Marry me, Lucita."

154.speaker: Lucita Azaro
154.text: "Is it unromantic of me to ask why?"

155.speaker: Player_Romus
155.text: "I've loved you since the moment you entered my council chambers."

156.speaker: Lucita Azaro
156.text: "I've loved you since before we even met."

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: She reached down, grabbed the back of my head and pulled my face level with hers.

161.speaker: Narrator
161.text: We kissed with such force that we nearly toppled to the ground. I wondered if any guards had eyes on us.

163.speaker: Narrator
163.text: She took my hand and pulled me towards the palace.

170.speaker: Narrator
170.text: Bruno was on my bed, lying atop a brand-new, crisp royal blue suit. Pabel had laid it out for me to wear tomorrow.

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: Atop my bed was a brand-new, crisp royal blue suit. Pabel had laid it out for me to wear tomorrow.
171.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BrunoDog_SleepsInBed"] == true) == false)

172.speaker: Narrator
172.text: Bruno was on my bed, lying atop my favorite suit. Pabel had laid it out for me to wear tomorrow.
172.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BrunoDog_SleepsInBed"] == true)

177.speaker: Narrator
177.text: Atop my bed was my favorite suit. Pabel had laid it out for me to wear tomorrow.
177.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BrunoDog_SleepsInBed"] == true) == false)

179.speaker: Narrator
179.text: I wondered what tomorrow would bring.

182.speaker: Narrator
182.text: In a daze, I slowly walked upstairs to my quarters.
182.conditionsRaw: (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_RizianForeignIntelligence_Expanded"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) == false)

186.speaker: Narrator
186.text: It was the night before Vina's wedding.

187.speaker: Narrator
187.text: After a day spent finalizing arrangements, conducting interviews and meeting with visiting guests, I was exhausted.

188.speaker: Narrator
188.text: After a day spent finalizing arrangements, holding press conferences and reviewing security details, I was exhausted.

189.speaker: Narrator
189.text: After an endless day of war briefings and strategy planning sessions, I was looking forward to collapsing in my bed.

193.speaker: Narrator
193.text: It was late at night at Palas Rezna.

197.speaker: Narrator
197.text: After an endless day of meetings, I was looking forward to collapsing in my bed.

201.speaker: Narrator
201.text: First, though, I decided to take a walk in the palace gardens to clear my head.
201.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false)

202.speaker: Narrator
202.text: I had just stepped onto the grounds when I bumped into Lucita.

204.speaker: Lucita Azaro
204.text: "I was just reviewing the latest strategies for the Zille resistance."
204.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_ViolentResistancePower"] > 0)

208.speaker: Lucita Azaro
208.text: "I was just reviewing our latest plans for dealing with the unrest."
208.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_ViolentResistancePower"] > 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true)

212.speaker: Lucita Azaro
212.text: "I was just reviewing the latest internal security reports."
212.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_ViolentResistancePower"] > 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false)

213.speaker: Player_Romus
213.text: "Look at us. Addicted to our jobs."

214.speaker: Player_Romus
214.text: "Nobody told me that ruling the country would be all this work."

218.speaker: Player_Romus
218.text: "It sounds like you're urgently in need of stress relief."

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "You've got too much on your plate. Why not share the load with the Golden Guard?"

224.speaker: Lucita Azaro
224.text: "At least you've got your council to fall back on."

225.speaker: Lucita Azaro
225.text: "There's no clocking out when the kingdom's future is at stake."

231.speaker: Lucita Azaro
231.text: "Vina Toras, Duchess of Valenqiris. The day has finally come."
231.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FullCouncilor"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true)

235.speaker: Narrator
235.text: It was the night before Vina's investiture ceremony as Duchess of Monqiz.

236.speaker: Narrator
236.text: The moon had risen by now, illuminating Lucita's features. I thought about everything we'd been through together.

241.speaker: Narrator
241.text: I thought about her position as councilor. Her 'interim' status had lasted longer than expected, but it was nearly time for her father to return.

242.speaker: Narrator
242.text: I thought about how, as of tomorrow, the heir to the throne of Rizia would not be a member of House Toras.

243.speaker: Narrator
243.text: I thought how, if Vina died in Pales, I would be left without an heir.

244.speaker: Narrator
244.text: My mother's words echoed in my head. "Unless..."
244.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Lucita_Together"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_BuildMaveNortusIntelHub_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Order_BuildMaveNortusIntelHub_Completed"] == true) == false)

247.speaker: Narrator
247.text: When we broke apart, she was grinning.

251.speaker: Narrator
251.text: She led me through the ground-floor corridors until we came to the entrance to Sal Ignacius' quarters.

252.speaker: Player_Romus
252.text: "What? You want to wake the old man up now?"

253.speaker: Player_Romus
253.text: "The Grand Wiseman? I still don't trust him."

260.speaker: Player_Romus
260.text: "Ah, a visit to my beloved spiritual advisor. Always a good idea."

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: "I think I see where this is going..."

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "We can't get in. It's been locked since his arrest."

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "The traitor's chambers? Why have you brought me here?"

264.speaker: Player_Romus
264.text: "No, I will not consummate our engagement in a holy man's bed, no matter how treasonous he turned out to be."

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "Consummating our engagement in a treasonous priest's bed? See, this is why I love you."

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: She put a finger to her lips, then took a keychain from her pocket and silently unlocked the door.

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "You want to go snooping for more evidence against him? Good idea."

271.speaker: Narrator
271.text: She put a finger to her lips and quietly rapped on the door.

272.speaker: Narrator
272.text: After almost a minute, it creaked open. Sal stood there in his dressing gown.

273.speaker: Sal Ignacius
273.text: "Your Majesty, Your Grace! Is there an emergency?"

274.speaker: Narrator
274.text: Lucita took my hand and stepped forward.

275.speaker: Lucita Azaro
275.text: "Grand Wiseman, His Majesty and I are in love and wish for you to sanctify our union by the sacrament of marriage. Now."

278.speaker: Player_Romus
278.text: "Her Grace has spoken correctly. As your King, I command you to perform the marriage rites."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "Need I remind you that my mercy saved you from imprisonment? You will do this for us, no questions asked."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "Would you rather we live in sin, Grand Wiseman?"

285.speaker: Lucita Azaro
285.text: "Why wait? It's what we want. And you know how frowned-upon garish second weddings are in royal circles."

289.speaker: Lucita Azaro
289.text: "Why wait? It's what we want. And it'll look desperate for our kingdom to put on two grand royal weddings in a row."

290.speaker: Sal Ignacius
290.text: "Yes, yes, of course. Give me one moment."

291.speaker: Sal Ignacius
291.text: "Of course, Your Grace. Give me one moment."

294.speaker: Sal Ignacius
294.text: "No, no, of course not. Give me one moment."

296.speaker: Player_Romus
296.text: "I still have Lena's wedding ring. Let me fetch it."

301.speaker: Player_Romus
301.text: "Don't you want your father to be here?"

302.speaker: Player_Romus
302.text: "Was this how you always dreamed your wedding would be?"

303.speaker: Lucita Azaro
303.text: "He never had any use for weddings. It'll be far more important for him to be present when we first address the troops together."

304.speaker: Lucita Azaro
304.text: "What's insane is spending endless amounts of time and resources to achieve exactly the same result."

305.speaker: Narrator
305.text: Her breath caught in her throat.

307.speaker: Player_Romus
307.text: "She would want you to have it. I'm sure of it."

308.speaker: Player_Romus
308.text: "It's been gathering dust on my table all these years. It'll look much better on your finger."

309.speaker: Player_Romus
309.text: "It symbolizes the continuity of our kingdom's relationship with Rumburg. The alliance endures, even if my marriage did not."

313.speaker: Player_Romus
313.text: "I'm sure. Imagine how furious it'll make Queen Beatrice to see you wearing it."

314.speaker: Narrator
314.text: I dashed up to my study and took Lena's ring from my desk. My mind flashed back to the all-too-brief time my first wife and I had spent together.

315.speaker: Narrator
315.text: When I made it back to Sal's quarters, the door was open. The Grand Wiseman, now dressed in ceremonial robes, beckoned us inside.

316.speaker: Lucita Azaro
316.text: "Mmhmm. Right down to the grass stain on my dress."

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: The door opened and Sal beckoned us inside, now dressed in ceremonial robes.

319.speaker: Sal Ignacius
319.text: "Because we are not in a sanctuary, some sacred traditions will have to be foregone. But your marriage shall still be valid before the Lord and the law."

321.speaker: Narrator
321.text: I clasped Lucita's hand in mine as we stood side by side in front of Sal. He opened an ancient-looking scroll and read from it.

322.speaker: Narrator
322.text: The room was as he'd left it: minimally furnished, with shelves full of books and sacred objects lining the walls.

323.speaker: Lucita Azaro
323.text: "Rizian law dictates that in the absence of a Grand Wiseman, the monarch is granted the ability to officiate marriages."

326.speaker: Lucita Azaro
326.text: "Why wait? It's what we want. And you know how frowned-upon garish second weddings are in royal circles."

330.speaker: Lucita Azaro
330.text: "Why wait? It's what we want. And it'll look desperate for our kingdom to put on two grand royal weddings in a row."

331.speaker: Player_Romus
331.text: "A wedding without boring religious speeches? Count me in."

335.speaker: Player_Romus
335.text: "True. I should practice doing this before Vina's wedding tomorrow."

337.speaker: Player_Romus
337.text: "I'm afraid it won't be legitimate before the Lord."

342.speaker: Lucita Azaro
342.text: "You're the King. You are the law."

343.speaker: Lucita Azaro
343.text: "You're the King. The Lord's will incarnate, supposedly."

344.speaker: Lucita Azaro
344.text: "It'll be easy. An oath here, a speech there."

348.speaker: Narrator
348.text: A wooden box was on Sal's desk, containing the materials needed for Vina's ceremony tomorrow. Lucita walked into the room and began poking through it.

349.speaker: Narrator
349.text: Lucita walked into the room and began browsing the shelves.

356.speaker: Narrator
356.text: When I made it back to Sal's quarters, the door was open. Lucita had lit a pair of candles and arranged a set of objects in a row on Sal's desk.

357.speaker: Narrator
357.text: I watched as she lit a pair of candles and arranged a set of objects in a row on Sal's desk.

358.speaker: Narrator
358.text: First in the row was a scroll. She handed it to me.

360.speaker: Sal Ignacius
360.text: "Almighty and ever-living God, who in Thy infinite wisdom hast blessed the union of two hearts in holy wedlock, look kindly upon His Majesty Romus Toras and Duchess Lucita Azaro, who stand before Thee, seeking Thy blessing."

361.speaker: Sal Ignacius
361.text: "In this sacred covenant, love and duty converge to forge a legacy that transcends the temporal realm. Let it be known that in the heart of such a union, the virtues of loyalty, honor, and commitment are the true jewels that adorn the crown of matrimonial sanctity."

362.speaker: Narrator
362.text: The royal orb was on his desk. He picked it up and motioned for us to place our joined hands upon it.

363.speaker: Sal Ignacius
363.text: "Now, repeat after me. I, Romus Toras..."

364.speaker: Player_Romus
364.text: "Wait. I want to say my own vows."

366.speaker: Player_Romus
366.text: "I vow to honor and uphold you..."

369.speaker: Sal Ignacius
369.text: "Again, highly unorthodox. But it will not nullify the marriage."

370.speaker: Narrator
370.text: Lucita looked at me. Her eyes shone brightly.

371.speaker: Player_Romus
371.text: "Lucita, I claim you not only as my queen, but as the ironclad partner to my reign."

372.speaker: Player_Romus
372.text: "As we defend our kingdom from our hordes of enemies, so shall we champion one another."

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "Together, we shall forge an unbreakable empire and crush all those who stand against us."

374.speaker: Player_Romus
374.text: "As the memory of my cherished Lena fades into the past, I stand here before you ready to love anew."

375.speaker: Player_Romus
375.text: "I offer you my heart, my loyalty, and my life, as we embark on this journey together."

376.speaker: Player_Romus
376.text: "I vow to honor the bond we have created with kindness and patience. I promise to be your steadfast rock through all the trials and triumphs that our days may bring."

377.speaker: Player_Romus
377.text: "I vow that I shall listen to every word you say -- well, except for when you're reviewing logistics reports. Who listens to those?"

378.speaker: Player_Romus
378.text: "Luce, the past few years I've spent with you have been the happiest in my entire life."

379.speaker: Player_Romus
379.text: "Whether in the chaos of council meetings or in the intimacy of moments alone, I feel I have truly found my equal."

380.speaker: Player_Romus
380.text: "I pledge myself to you not as a king to his queen, but as a man eager to spend the rest of his life with the woman he loves."

390.speaker: Player_Romus
390.text: "Duchess Azaro, just as we have navigated the waters of international diplomacy, so too will we chart a course through holy matrimony."

391.speaker: Player_Romus
391.text: "Together, let us usher in a new era for our kingdom, marked by strength, resilience, and the legacy of the heirs that shall spring from your still-fertile loins."

392.speaker: Player_Romus
392.text: "Together, we are more than the sum of our parts. We are bound by shared ambition and mutual respect."

393.speaker: Narrator

394.speaker: Player_Romus
394.text: "Let our marriage be the foundation upon which we build a legacy of peace and prosperity, for our kingdom and for the generations that will follow."

396.speaker: Narrator

397.speaker: Player_Romus
397.text: "If we're going to break tradition, I want to go all the way. I'll recite my own vows."

398.text: "As you wish. It's just us and the Lord anyway."

405.speaker: Sal Ignacius

406.speaker: Narrator

407.speaker: Narrator

412.text: "As the queen on a chessboard guards her king, so do I vow to protect you and this kingdom, Romus Toras."

413.speaker: Lucita Azaro
413.text: "As the queen on a chessboard guards her king, so do I vow to protect you and this kingdom, Romus Toras."

416.speaker: Sal Ignacius
416.text: "This oil is infused with the protection of our Lord and the strength and blessings of our ancestors. As you anoint one another, be reminded of your promises to serve each other, the Lord and this realm."

448.speaker: Player_Romus
448.text: "It's beautiful. I'll wear it with pride."

450.speaker: Sal Ignacius
450.text: "By the power vested in me, through the divine grace and the laws that govern our land, I now pronounce you husband and wife."

454.speaker: Player_Romus
454.text: "By the power vested in me, through the divine grace and the laws that govern our land, I now pronounce us husband and wife."

455.speaker: Sal Ignacius

456.speaker: Player_Romus
456.text: "As the sovereign of this realm, I name you as my queen. Now and forever more."

457.speaker: Narrator

461.speaker: Narrator

489.text: Since I'd done away with Rizia's anti-homosexuality laws, we had started to be less secretive about our meetings, though we still had not mentioned our relationship to anyone in the palace or beyond.

493.speaker: Pabel Adria

501.text: "She lives on in Her Highness. And in all of her descendents, whoever they may be..."

505.speaker: Pabel Adria

506.speaker: Pabel Adria

508.speaker: Pabel Adria

522.speaker: Narrator
522.text: He dropped his arms to his sides. His fists curled in frustration.

523.speaker: Player_Romus
523.text: "Vina's a hostage. Hugo and Rico's side of the family will probably inherit the throne anyway. It doesn't matter what I do."

525.speaker: Pabel Adria
525.text: "You have a modicum of protection as the king. But the moment the truth gets out about us, I'll be torn apart from all sides."

526.speaker: Player_Romus
526.text: "Let the papers say what they will. I'm not afraid for my reputation."

530.speaker: Player_Romus
530.text: "Titles mean nothing, Pabel. I see you as a friend and an equal, regardless of our stations."

532.speaker: Pabel Adria
532.text: "But the rest of the kingdom doesn't."

533.speaker: Pabel Adria
533.text: "I know that decriminalizing homosexuality came at a great cost to your popularity. But I'm so glad you did it."

534.speaker: Player_Romus
534.text: "It's just a shame that you and I can't enjoy that freedom for ourselves."

535.speaker: Player_Romus
535.text: "It might be legal for us to see each other, but I still rather enjoy the secrecy of it all."

538.speaker: Pabel Adria
538.text: "A king openly dating a man is cause enough for scandal, but a commoner? And a member of his household staff, at that?"

539.speaker: Player_Romus
539.text: "I might no longer be breaking the law, but I'm still a very bad boy who needs to be punished."

540.speaker: Pabel Adria
540.text: "Easy there, Your Majesty. We can't throw all caution to the wind yet."

541.speaker: Narrator
541.text: A glint appeared in his eye. He shook his head.

542.speaker: Player_Romus
542.text: "My popularity with *Rizians*. The Derdians love me now."

545.speaker: Pabel Adria
545.text: "But I'm still dreading what will happen if the rumors about us ever spread beyond palace walls."

546.speaker: Player_Romus
546.text: "You grew up in this palace. You hardly count as a commoner."

547.speaker: Pabel Adria
547.text: "My family's legacy is tending to other people's land. We have none of our own."

548.speaker: Pabel Adria
548.text: "And if something happens to you, or things end badly between us? Rom, I'll have nothing."

549.speaker: Player_Romus
549.text: "Nothing will ever happen to me. I'm basically immortal."

550.speaker: Player_Romus
550.text: "It will never end badly between us."

551.speaker: Player_Romus
551.text: "Then we'll continue in secret. As we always have."

553.speaker: Player_Romus
553.text: "What if I were to confer noble status upon you?"

559.speaker: Player_Romus
559.text: "It's strictly a symbolic title now that the electoral reforms have been enacted. But you wouldn't be a commoner anymore."

560.speaker: Player_Romus
560.text: "I grant you a piece of land and make you a lord. Like my mother's family, or Daria de Rava."

561.speaker: Player_Romus
561.text: "You'd have to take on one or two extra responsibilities. But you wouldn't be a commoner anymore."

562.speaker: Player_Romus
562.text: "*If* anything were to disrupt our relationship, you'd still have an estate to fall back on."

563.speaker: Narrator
563.text: Pabel mulled it over for a second.

565.speaker: Player_Romus
565.text: "Hugo would have to make it official. Shall we go fetch him now?"

569.speaker: Narrator
569.text: He laughed and kissed me on the forehead.

571.speaker: Narrator
571.text: He laughed and kissed me on the forehead.

574.speaker: Pabel Adria
574.text: "I'll let you rest. Big day tomorrow."

579.speaker: Narrator
579.text: He gave me an excited hug.

580.speaker: Pabel Adria
580.text: "I'll do it. I'm your butler, after all."

581.speaker: Narrator
581.text: Not long afterwards, Hugo, Pabel and I convened in the Grand Vizier's chambers.

582.speaker: Narrator
582.text: My uncle uneasily glanced from one of us to another.

584.speaker: Hugo Toras
584.text: "A head butler, joining the gentry. I must say I've never heard of such a thing."

588.speaker: Player_Romus
588.text: "You know I'm not one to play by the rules, Hugo."

589.speaker: Player_Romus
589.text: "Pabel has spent his entire life in service to the Royal Family. He deserves a reward."

590.speaker: Player_Romus
590.text: "He's not only my butler, he's my close friend."

591.speaker: Player_Romus
591.text: "It's a symbolic gesture. It won't change anything."

596.speaker: Hugo Toras
596.text: "It sets a dangerous precedent. We can't have every scullery maid in the palace clamoring to be a lady."

601.speaker: Hugo Toras
601.text: "I assume His Majesty has told you of the unfair taxes that will be levied upon you."

605.speaker: Narrator
605.text: He turned away from us and pulled out an enormous book of records. After rifling though it for a while, he put his finger on one of the entries.

606.speaker: Hugo Toras
606.text: "The Veridian estate on the outskirts of Malcos. It's lain abandoned for years after an unresolved inheritance dispute, but its famous orchards are as fecund as ever."

608.speaker: Hugo Toras
608.text: "I will warn you not to take on any tenants. You'll never be able to get rid of them."

610.speaker: Hugo Toras
610.text: "With your title comes great responsibility. I hope you are ready for it."

611.speaker: Pabel Adria
611.text: "I served two royal households, Your Grace. I am ready."

612.speaker: Pabel Adria
612.text: "Your advice has been noted, Your Grace."

613.speaker: Pabel Adria
613.text: "I will pay what I must, Your Grace."

614.speaker: Narrator
614.text: Hugo busied himself at his desk for a few minutes, then held up a piece of parchment.

615.speaker: Hugo Toras
615.text: "Here is the letters patent. It needs your signature and the King's seal, and then the deed is yours."

616.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
616.text: Put your seal on the document.

617.speaker: Narrator
617.text: Pabel added his signature. Hugo nodded solemnly.

618.speaker: Player_Romus
618.text: "I hereby proclaim you Lord Pabel Adria of Veridian. May your actions reflect the honor of your title."

619.speaker: Narrator

621.speaker: Player_Romus
621.text: "As you have served me as a butler, so now do I entrust you with the care of your own domain. May you tend to it as thoughtfully as you tend to me."

622.speaker: Narrator
622.text: He gave me a quick kiss and walked out.

626.speaker: Narrator
626.text: Bruno was on my bed yet again. He whimpered disappointedly as Pabel left.

627.speaker: Narrator
627.text: From his corner, Bruno whimpered disappointedly as Pabel left.

633.speaker: Narrator
633.text: Bruno quieted down and rolled over on his side as I began my bedtime routine.

634.speaker: Narrator
634.text: Pabel grinned from ear to ear.

636.text: Hugo shook Pabel's hand and handed him the document.

641.speaker: Pabel Adria
641.text: "I didn't get the chance. There was a snag with the seating arrangements. Some fool from the wedding committee placed the Qinali and Free Cities delegations next to each other."

642.speaker: Hugo Toras
642.text: "But your many years of service to this household do deserve acknowledgement, Mr. Adria."

646.speaker: Hugo Toras
646.text: "Don't let it get to your head. We need all your focus on coordinating tomorrow's festivities."

647.speaker: Player_Romus
647.text: "May this mark the beginning of a new era, where titles are not inherited but earned by merit."

648.speaker: Narrator

650.speaker: Player_Romus
650.text: "The institution of nobility is a relic of a bygone era, one that perpetuates inequality and stifles the true potential of our people. But enjoy the fruit trees."

654.speaker: Narrator
654.text: Hugo coughed. Pabel, grinning from ear to ear, ignored him.

656.speaker: Player_Romus
656.text: "Nonsense. Lord Adria will accompany me to the ceremony."

657.speaker: Player_Romus
657.text: "It's true, Pabel. You've got to hold on to your head butler duties, at least until a replacement is found."

658.speaker: Hugo Toras
658.text: "Congratulations, Lord Adria. Don't let it get to your head."

659.speaker: Narrator
659.text: Pabel and Hugo appeared equally surprised.

660.speaker: Pabel Adria
660.text: "Why... it would be an honor, Your Majesty."

661.speaker: Pabel Adria
661.text: "Of course, Your Majesty. I'll make sure tomorrow goes off without a hitch."

662.speaker: Narrator
662.text: My uncle stared in open amazement as we left.

663.speaker: Narrator

668.speaker: Pabel Adria
668.text: "I can't believe it's been a year since Her Highness was taken hostage."
668.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_FullCouncilor"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true) == false)

672.speaker: Player_Romus
672.text: "We're going to get her back. I can feel it in my bones."

673.speaker: Player_Romus
673.text: "When we win this war, Pales will pay for what they did to her."

674.speaker: Player_Romus
674.text: "The Azaros seem to have given up hope of finding her. Perhaps I should as well."

675.speaker: Player_Romus
675.text: "You don't have to remind me. I've been counting the days."

679.speaker: Player_Romus
679.text: "That's what she gets for being such a brat to me."

685.speaker: Pabel Adria

696.speaker: Lucita Azaro

698.speaker: Lucita Azaro
698.text: "I can't help but feel personally responsible that she hasn't made it home yet."

699.speaker: Player_Romus
699.text: "When we win this war, Pales will pay for what they did to her."

703.speaker: Player_Romus
703.text: "You don't need to tell me how long it's been. I've been counting every single day."

704.speaker: Player_Romus
704.text: "Don't blame yourself. Blame your goddamn fool of a father."

705.speaker: Player_Romus
705.text: "No, it's my fault for sending her there in the first place.''

706.speaker: Lucita Azaro
706.text: "You couldn't have known what would happen."

708.speaker: Lucita Azaro
708.text: "I should have spoken against him. He hardly even knew the Princess."

723.speaker: Narrator
723.text: Bruno was pacing around next to it. He seemed agitated.

724.speaker: Narrator
724.text: I looked at my bed. There was a piece of paper on it.

728.speaker: Pabel Adria
728.text: "I write these words with a heavy heart."

729.speaker: Pabel Adria
729.text: "I will never forget the years I spent serving your family, nor the time you and I shared together."

730.speaker: Pabel Adria
730.text: "I have not lost hope that time will bring forth change -- in our nation and in your own heart."

731.speaker: Pabel Adria
731.text: "But in the end, my deepest loyalty must be to myself."

735.speaker: Pabel Adria
735.text: "I wish Her Highness all the happiness in the world. But the thought of celebrating her love while the law still forces us to conceal our own fills me with unbearable sorrow."

736.speaker: Pabel Adria
736.text: "I can no longer bear silent witness as you deny your daughter, your country and yourself the freedom to love."

741.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

742.speaker: Narrator

744.speaker: Narrator

752.speaker: Narrator

753.speaker: Narrator

754.text: I took him to the Grand Vizier's chambers, where Hugo used to keep the book of records for such estates.

755.speaker: Narrator

756.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

758.speaker: Player_Romus

759.speaker: Narrator
759.text: Pabel grinned from ear to ear.

761.speaker: Player_Romus
761.text: "As you have served me as a butler, so now do I entrust you with the care of your own domain. May you tend to it as thoughtfully as you tend to me."

762.speaker: Narrator
762.text: Pabel grinned from ear to ear.

764.speaker: Player_Romus
764.text: "May this mark the beginning of a new era, where titles are not inherited but earned by merit."

765.speaker: Narrator
765.text: Pabel grinned from ear to ear.

767.speaker: Player_Romus
767.text: "The institution of nobility is a relic of a bygone era, one that perpetuates inequality and stifles the true potential of our people. But enjoy the fruit trees."

773.speaker: Narrator
773.text: Pabel grinned from ear to ear.

783.speaker: Narrator
783.text: We left the Grand Vizier's chambers together.

793.speaker: Player_Romus
793.text: "No, I surrender to you. I want you to be Rizia's new Queen Consort."

794.speaker: Player_Romus
794.text: "That's all I wanted to know. Good night."

795.speaker: Narrator
795.text: Lucita grabbed my arm. She made an effort to keep a pleasant expression on her face.

797.speaker: Lucita Azaro
797.text: "I have to know. Do you ever intend to have another child?"

798.speaker: Player_Romus
798.text: "It won't be easy to rest. But I'll try."

799.speaker: Player_Romus
799.text: "No. I have to do something. I'll go crazy otherwise."

800.speaker: Narrator
800.text: She looked in both directions, then grabbed my arm.

801.speaker: Player_Romus
801.text: "How can you ask me that right now? With my daughter Lord knows where..."

805.speaker: Player_Romus
805.text: "No. Just the one was enough for me."

807.speaker: Lucita Azaro
807.text: "I hate to say it, but: exactly. You must be aware that you need a backup plan in case Her Highness doesn't return."

808.speaker: Lucita Azaro
808.text: "And, well, I'm not getting any younger."

809.speaker: Narrator
809.text: She looked me in the eye.

811.speaker: Lucita Azaro
811.text: "Of course, if you did have a second child, he or she would have to be legitimate to qualify for the throne."

812.speaker: Lucita Azaro
812.text: "Not to mention... You know I've been careful. But an illegitimate child between the two of us could throw the kingdom into chaos."

813.speaker: Narrator
813.text: She looked me in the eye.

815.speaker: Lucita Azaro
815.text: "I'm not getting any younger. And it isn't my intention to die an old maid or secret mistress."

816.speaker: Player_Romus
816.text: "You've made your point. I want to marry you, Lucita. But I've already shelled out for one royal wedding."

820.speaker: Player_Romus
820.text: "Are you trying to wheedle a proposal out of me? It won't work."

821.speaker: Player_Romus
821.text: "Please don't take this personally. But no, I do not wish to have a child with you. My daughter must remain my successor, no matter what."

822.speaker: Player_Romus
822.text: "Then by all means, Duchess, let us be wed posthaste."

826.speaker: Player_Romus
826.text: "I'm sorry too. Sorry you only wanted me for my royal seed."

828.speaker: Player_Romus
828.text: "If we were not royals, this wouldn't be so complicated."

831.speaker: Lucita Azaro
831.text: "I know. But I've been thinking about it for some time."

833.speaker: Lucita Azaro
833.text: "Alas, this is the only life we have. And I don't want to waste mine."

838.speaker: Lucita Azaro
838.text: "Good night, Your Majesty. I'll see you at the wedding tomorrow."

842.speaker: Narrator
842.text: She turned and walked away from me, breaking into a jog as she reached the edge of the clearing.

844.speaker: Lucita Azaro
844.text: "Good night, Your Majesty. I'll see you at our next council meeting."

845.speaker: Narrator
845.text: That was it. Just as soon as I had found new love, I'd lost it again.

850.speaker: Narrator
850.text: I hoped Vina would be luckier.

858.speaker: Lucita Azaro
858.text: "She can be your successor if you like. You're the king, you make the rules."

859.speaker: Player_Romus
859.text: "I don't think you mean that. The second I impregnate you, the Azaros will be scrambling to get Vina out of the picture."

860.speaker: Narrator
860.text: A hurt look formed on her face.

861.speaker: Lucita Azaro
861.text: "If that's the level of trust you have for me and my family... then this is over."

862.speaker: Player_Romus
862.text: "If you truly will accept it if Vina stays first in line for the throne... then yes. Let's get married."

863.speaker: Player_Romus
863.text: "That may be true. But I still find it too risky to muddy up the line of succession. I'm sorry."

864.speaker: Narrator
864.text: A hurt look formed on her face.

867.speaker: Player_Romus
867.text: "I can't bring another child into this world, Lucita."

869.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
869.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == false

870.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
870.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_DuchessOfValenqiris"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Rico"] == false) == false

881.speaker: Lucita Azaro
881.text: "Did you ever love me? Or were you just looking to use my armies to consolidate your power?"

883.speaker: Lucita Azaro
883.text: "I have a rather more low-budget idea. If you'll permit me."

885.speaker: Player_Romus
885.text: "I haven't even proposed yet. Lucita Azaro, will you marry me?"

886.speaker: Player_Romus
886.text: "Wait. This all happening too fast. I've got cold feet. I'm sorry."

889.speaker: Player_Romus
889.text: "We can still have a monarcho-military alliance without literally uniting our bloodlines."
